title: Alliance Duel
description: PvP event against the opposing alliance.
guide: Check Radar roughly every 8 hours. Finish tasks on Sunday and Thursday, but open the chests on Monday and Friday – points come when you open them. Stay below the Radar limit or new tasks are lost.
Full Preparedness: the points windows are at {{apo 08:00}} and {{apo 20:00}}.
Saturday (Enemy Buster day): free server teleport to the opposing server. The return trip lands randomly in your alliance hive, then a 20-second wait applies.

title: Server War
description: PvP event against the opposing server.
guide: Sunday to Friday: collect points (see “Battle for the Right to Invade”). The server with more points gets the right to invade and attacks.
Saturday: battle for the capital. It lasts 4 hours or until a server has captured the capital to 100%.
Goal for everyone: unlock the 9 personal reward boxes (2.25M points in total). This counts even if your server loses.
Valor Medals can be exchanged for orange equipment.

title: Zombie Tyrant
description: PvE event against the Zombie Tyrant.
guide: Only start or join rallies with 7 to 8 members.
Fill open rallies first, then start new ones.
Recall your troops about 5 minutes before the start.
R4/R5 summon the Tyrant, then 15 minutes run. The alliance needs more than 20 members.
Can't be there live? Enable “Engage offline”.

title: Canyon Clash
description: PvP event against an opposing alliance.
guide: Weekly flow: voting Mon/Tue, registration Wed, matchmaking Thu, combat on Friday.
Requirements: alliance in the top 20, at least 40 members, players in the alliance for 24+ hours.
Structure: 10 minutes prep, 40 minutes combat, 10 minutes settlement.
Goal: control buildings instead of chasing kills. Only carry Energy Cells with an escort.
The exact time is in the Event Center under Canyon Clash (in Apocalypse Time).
